verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented telemetry or usage-tracking setting, and nothing saying the product does or does not collect usage data. The docs do say Open WebUI is 'built to run entirely offline' and offers an air-gapped enterprise mode. Those are deployment and network-isolation postures adjacent to this story, not a documented opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
